title: Build a Question · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Build a Question · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and a common object. One player begins a question about the object and the partner completes it. The completed sentence is an understandable question about the object. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Build a Question, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The completed sentence is an understandable question about the object.
recall.why: The completed sentence is an understandable question about the object.
